mapper.select: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM mes_pro_work_order WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY status
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM mes_dv_machinery WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY status
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mes_pro_andon_record WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = ${@cn.iocoder.txgy.module.mes.enums.pro.MesProAndonStatusEnum@ACTIVE.status}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mes_dv_repair WHERE deleted = 0 AND status IN (${@cn.iocoder.txgy.module.mes.enums.dv.MesDvRepairStatusEnum@PREPARE.status}, ${@cn.iocoder.txgy.module.mes.enums.dv.MesDvRepairStatusEnum@CONFIRMED.status}, ${@cn.iocoder.txgy.module.mes.enums.dv.MesDvRepairStatusEnum@APPROVING.status})

SELECT 'IQC' AS qcType, COUNT(*) AS docCount, IFNULL(SUM(check_quantity), 0) AS checkQuantity, IFNULL(SUM(qualified_quantity), 0) AS qualifiedQuantity, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN check_result = ${@cn.iocoder.txgy.module.mes.enums.qc.MesQcCheckResultEnum@PASS.type} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS passDocCount FROM mes_qc_iqc WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = ${@cn.iocoder.txgy.module.mes.enums.qc.MesQcStatusEnum@FINISHED.status} AND inspect_date >= #{beginTime} AND inspect_date < #{endTime} UNION ALL SELECT 'IPQC' AS qcType, COUNT(*) AS docCount, IFNULL(SUM(check_quantity), 0) AS checkQuantity, IFNULL(SUM(qualified_quantity), 0) AS qualifiedQuantity, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN check_result = ${@cn.iocoder.txgy.module.mes.enums.qc.MesQcCheckResultEnum@PASS.type} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS passDocCount FROM mes_qc_ipqc WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = ${@cn.iocoder.txgy.module.mes.enums.qc.MesQcStatusEnum@FINISHED.status} AND inspect_date >= #{beginTime} AND inspect_date < #{endTime} UNION ALL SELECT 'OQC' AS qcType, COUNT(*) AS docCount, IFNULL(SUM(check_quantity), 0) AS checkQuantity, IFNULL(SUM(qualified_quantity), 0) AS qualifiedQuantity, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN check_result = ${@cn.iocoder.txgy.module.mes.enums.qc.MesQcCheckResultEnum@PASS.type} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS passDocCount FROM mes_qc_oqc WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = ${@cn.iocoder.txgy.module.mes.enums.qc.MesQcStatusEnum@FINISHED.status} AND inspect_date >= #{beginTime} AND inspect_date < #{endTime} UNION ALL SELECT 'RQC' AS qcType, COUNT(*) AS docCount, IFNULL(SUM(check_quantity), 0) AS checkQuantity, IFNULL(SUM(qualified_quantity), 0) AS qualifiedQuantity, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN check_result = ${@cn.iocoder.txgy.module.mes.enums.qc.MesQcCheckResultEnum@PASS.type} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS passDocCount FROM mes_qc_rqc WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = ${@cn.iocoder.txgy.module.mes.enums.qc.MesQcStatusEnum@FINISHED.status} AND inspect_date >= #{beginTime} AND inspect_date < #{endTime}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN status = ${@cn.iocoder.txgy.module.mes.enums.pro.MesProAndonStatusEnum@HANDLED.status} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS handledCount, IFNULL(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, create_time, handle_time)), 0) AS avgHandleMinutes FROM mes_pro_andon_record WHERE deleted = 0 AND create_time >= #{beginTime} AND create_time < #{endTime}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN status = ${@cn.iocoder.txgy.module.mes.enums.dv.MesDvRepairStatusEnum@FINISHED.status} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS finishedCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN result = ${@cn.iocoder.txgy.module.mes.enums.dv.MesDvRepairResultEnum@PASS.result} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS passCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN result = ${@cn.iocoder.txgy.module.mes.enums.dv.MesDvRepairResultEnum@FAIL.result} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS failCount, IFNULL(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, require_date, finish_date)), 0) AS avgRepairHours FROM mes_dv_repair WHERE deleted = 0 AND require_date >= #{beginTime} AND require_date < #{endTime}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mes_pro_work_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND status NOT IN (${@cn.iocoder.txgy.module.mes.enums.pro.MesProWorkOrderStatusEnum@FINISHED.status}, ${@cn.iocoder.txgy.module.mes.enums.pro.MesProWorkOrderStatusEnum@CANCELED.status}) AND request_date IS NOT NULL AND request_date < NOW()

SELECT COUNT(*) AS recordCount, IFNULL(SUM(quantity), 0) AS totalQuantity, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN level = ${@cn.iocoder.txgy.module.mes.enums.qc.MesQcDefectLevelEnum@CRITICAL.type} THEN quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS criticalQuantity, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN level = ${@cn.iocoder.txgy.module.mes.enums.qc.MesQcDefectLevelEnum@MAJOR.type} THEN quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS majorQuantity, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN level = ${@cn.iocoder.txgy.module.mes.enums.qc.MesQcDefectLevelEnum@MINOR.type} THEN quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS minorQuantity FROM mes_qc_defect_record WHERE deleted = 0 AND create_time >= #{beginTime} AND create_time < #{endTime}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN status = ${@cn.iocoder.txgy.module.mes.enums.dv.MesDvCheckPlanStatusEnum@ENABLED.status} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS enabledCount FROM mes_dv_check_plan WHERE deleted = 0
